High’Trade International offers a great number of solutions making them the smartest choice.” A Long Term Vision Our independence is a guarantee of our stability . We have a long-term vision and transparency with our customers. We develop projects hand in hand with our customers in order to meet the defined objectives. Our experience We have more than 20 years of experience in home appliances. Therefore, we know more than 200 reliable manufacturers located in southern China. In other words, if you are looking for a specific item or new product, we can easily find the best manufacturer for you in China . Since the opening of our company, we have successfully identified very good manufacturers for several large companies in Europe and the United States . Our Customers We are driven to do the best job possible. We pride ourselves on cultivating lasting client relationships built on trust and mutual respect. 65% of our customers come to us for cost saving purposes .
